Install:

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable OVERDRIVE 2D perspective racing game with destination and car selection, a behind-the-car camera, and 11 racers total.

## Requirements
- Include all 13 destinations and all 20 cars, organized into Supercars, Japanese Cars, and Classic Cars.
- Race against 10 bots; provide a playable racing experience.
- Keep graphics realistic-looking but 2D, with a camera behind the car.
- Include keyboard and touch controls, nitro, pause, and race results.
- No clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them on completion.

## Decisions
- Use a 2D canvas racer with a perspective road and illustrated rear-view cars.
- Use AI opponents rather than online multiplayer; races are three laps.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented destination and car selection, canvas rendering, 10 bot racers, HUD, countdown, keyboard/touch controls, nitro, pause/resume, and finish/results logic.
- Added `package.json` with an `npm start` script.
- Fixed canvas intercepting UI clicks by setting `pointer-events:none`.
- `node --check game.js` passes.
- Browser-tested selecting a destination and car, starting a race, steering, nitro, pause, and resume; 13 destinations and 20 cars appeared as expected.
- Saved screenshots to `/tmp/opencode/overdrive-menu.jpg` and `/tmp/opencode/overdrive-race.jpg`.

### Active
- Validate race completion and results screen; gameplay test only covered initial race controls.
- Confirm `npm start` behavior when port 3000 is available.

### Blocked
- `npm start` exited with `EADDRINUSE` on port 3000 because a server was already listening there; that server successfully served the app.
- Playwright CLI could not launch its expected browser installation, so browser testing used Playwright Core with `/usr/bin/chromium`.

## Next Move
1. Test the race through the finish and verify results, restart, and next destination.
2. Check for browser console errors during extended play.
3. Re-test `npm start` with an available port or document the port-3000 conflict.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game logic, AI racers, rendering, controls, HUD, and race lifecycle.
- `index.html`: Menu, selection, race HUD, touch controls, pause, and results markup.
- `styles.css`: Responsive visual design and pointer-event fix.
- `server.js`: Static-file server.
- `package.json`: `npm start` script.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- `/tmp/opencode/overdrive-menu.jpg` and `/tmp/opencode/overdrive-race.jpg` are current browser screenshots.
